news.analysis: Lawrence had a fantastic game against the Titans' woeful defense. He's been in MVP form for some time now, and the Jaguars are rolling. He has had at least three touchdowns in three of his last four games, and he will get to face the Giants next weekend.

news.analysis: Brown finally had an explosive game on Sunday night. He racked up 83 total yards on the night and was able to get into the end zone twice through the air, which left him with a fantastic fantasy total. This should give fantasy managers confidence that he will be a good option over the back half of the season, although he still seems prone to some bad performances on a week-to-week basis.
